items.title: Third-quarter GDP already looked great. Now it looks even better.
items.content: The economy grew in the late spring and summer at the fastest pace in three years to set the U.S. up for a strong finish in 2026. Gross domestic product expanded at a 4.3% annual pace in the third quarter, up from an initial estimate of a 3.4%.
